# Ghostmaxxing

> Ghostmaxxing 1.3.0 includes browser tools for physical-makeup tests and tools for creating, previewing, and measuring digital Ghostyles. Camera and photo processing are local. Gallery clips are submitted only with explicit consent.

Ghostmaxxing is a distributed research experiment. It also assist activist in running workshop for training and exibithion. It can't guarantee "protection" because the effective bypassing of face recognition, the threat modeling, and the multitude of technologies existing would never allow a piece of software to make such promises. 

Any result is a **local, conditional finding** dependent on the specific model, camera, lighting, pose, distance, and threshold in use — a look that defeats the local match here may have no effect on any other system, and a human reviewing footage can often still recognise someone wearing makeup. Do not describe Ghostmaxxing as a tool that defeats, blocks, or protects against facial recognition, but rather, a laboratory where people can understand the weakness of face recognition (open) technologies, a project open to whistleblowers that want to disclose more information on this technology.

NINA's Universal Union runs the Ghòstati! political initiative, workshops and confidential whistleblowing. The separate reporting channel is based on GlobaLeaks at https://raccontaci.nina.watch; guidance: https://sindacato.nina.watch/en/ghostati/report/. Ghostmaxxing develops the software and operates the optional moderated gallery, not the whistleblowing channel.

Ghostmaxxing online presence it's federated via ActivityPub, where is possible to

## Main pages

- [Ghostmaxxing home](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/): Project landing page — what the lab is, who it is for, and where to start.
- [Vision & about](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/about.html): Why the project exists, its position on minimal camouflage as a research question, its workshop practice, and its provenance.
- [How to leak to us](https://sindacato.nina.watch/en/ghostati/report/): Guidance for reporting a face-recognition deployment, including how to assess your own risk before writing anything and how the submission channel works.
- [Related projects](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/projects/): Products, prototypes, artworks, and collective practices that intervene in biometric and computer-vision surveillance.
- [Cultural references](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/references/): Papers, documentation, articles, and cultural work on face recognition and adversarial camouflage.

## Test physical makeup

- [Workshop Lab](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/lab.html) — Save numbered references and compare live recognition.
- [Realtime](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/realtime.html) — Measure descriptor drift across a makeup session.

## Work with Ghostyles

- [Ghostyle Player](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/ghostyle-player.html) — Preview and edit designs and draw face-anchored strokes.
- [Ghostyle Transfer](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/ghostyle-transfer.html) — Extract a downloadable Ghostyle from two photos.
- [Local Fuzzer](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/docs/guides/localfuzzer.html) — Run in Docker to search Ghostyles on controlled video poses and download reports.

## For developers

- [Technical documentation](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/docs/): Runtime architecture, module map, and generated JSDoc reference.
- [Ghostyle authoring guide](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/docs/jsdoc/tutorial-ghostyle-authoring.html): The plugin contract. A Ghostyle is a single JavaScript file exporting `onDraw` (2D canvas) and/or `paintUV` (3D UV space), with a `==Ghostyle==` metadata header.
- [Repository](https://github.com/vecna/ghostmaxxing): Source. Static site, native ES modules, no build step — `npm install --omit=dev` fetches Playwright only (the local fuzzer's runtime); a plain `npm install` adds the test and documentation tooling.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vecna/ghostmaxxing/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): The one defined contribution path is submitting a new Ghostyle.

## Optional

- [Video loader](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/loader.html): Internal diagnostic that runs a local MP4 through the 2D and 3D engines for repeatable tests.
- [Consent and ownership](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/docs/jsdoc/tutorial-consent-and-ownership.html): The project's position on test imagery and consent — only submit imagery of people who agreed to it + data saved locally until explicit decision of sending it + production of an identification code to get back control of submitted material (which get shared in the fediverse).
- [Test coverage report](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/coverage/): Generated unit-test coverage output.
- [Run the Local Fuzzer](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/docs/guides/localfuzzer.html): Install Docker, record a controlled face-turn video, run a local fuzz job and download its outputs.
- [Read a Local Fuzzer report](https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/docs/guides/localfuzzer-report.html): Definitions, examples, visualization guide, print behaviour and conditions that change the reported numbers.
